items.title: Harry Edison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bill Coleman, Stuff Smith, Kenny Drew, Kenny Clarke, Johnny Griffin is still living but he’s still over there in Europe.

ctx.x: Bill Coleman, Stuff Smith, Kenny Drew, Kenny Clarke, Johnny Griffin is still living but he’s still over there in Europe. You get some much, you’re appreciated so much over there.
Were you ever tempted to settle there permanently?
